source.title: 3 Fantasy Football Sleepers: Wide Receivers
source.author: Frank Ammirante
source.summary: Three final-round receiver bets based primarily on paths to volume.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Tucker has emerged as Las Vegas' lead receiver and has rapport with Kirk Cousins, creating a clear path to late-round volume.
takeaways.rationale: Tucker has emerged as Las Vegas' lead receiver and has rapport with Kirk Cousins, creating a clear path to late-round volume.
risks: The offense and quarterback transition still limit certainty.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boutte's trade to Houston gives him a plausible No. 2 role and deep-target opportunity with C.J. Stroud.
takeaways.rationale: Boutte's trade to Houston gives him a plausible No. 2 role and deep-target opportunity with C.J. Stroud.
risks: His ADP may rise and the role must be confirmed.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Washington is a PPR-oriented bet to lead Miami in receptions because of limited established target competition.
takeaways.rationale: Washington is a PPR-oriented bet to lead Miami in receptions because of limited established target competition.
risks: Miami may be run-heavy and the underneath role is less valuable in non-PPR.
